(Rate as per LQR) Commando Net

Providing,  supplying, hand  weaving,  fabricating  and  installing  a complete Elephant Hammock adventure activity, consisting of high-strength nylon rope hand woven netting with 8 mm diameter inner rope, approximately 5 inch 5 inch mesh opening and overall size of 20 ft 15 ft, including all necessary fixtures, connection   accessories, fixing arrangements and   installation, complete as per approved design, drawings and instructions

Providing and supplying 12 mm nominal diameter galvanized steel wire rope, of 6 19 construction with Independent Wire Rope Core (IWRC)/steel core, manufactured  from  high  tensile  strength  steel  wires,  with  1960  N/mm² minimum  nominal  tensile trength,  suitable  for  use  in  outdoor,  structural, lifting, zip-line, suspension and other engineering applications. The wire rope shall consist of 6 strands, each containing 19 wires, laid uniformly around an independent  steel  wire  rope  core,  and  shall  be  properly  preformed  and lubricated  during  manufacture.  The  rope  shall  be  hot-dip  galvanized/zinc coated  for  enhanced  resistance  against  corrosion,  rust  and  atmospheric exposure.  The  wire  rope  shall  have  uniform  diameter,  proper  lay,  freedom from    kinks,    broken    wires,    excessive    corrosion,    flattening    or    other manufacturing  defects.  The  galvanized  coating  shall  be  continuous  and firmly bonded  to the steel wire surface. The wire rope shall conform to the relevant   requirements   of   IS   2266  Steel   Wire   Ropes   for   General Engineering  Purposes  and  applicable  ISO  standard

Providing  and supplying  12 mm Wire  Rope  Clamps  (M12 size) suitable for securing and terminating 12 mm diameter steel wire ropes, complete with U-bolt,  forged   grooved   saddle   and   hexagonal   nuts.  The   clamp   shall  be manufactured from hot-dip galvanized mild steel or Grade 304/316 stainless steel as specified, with accurately machined threads and corrosion-resistant finish suitable  for outdoor structural and  engineering applications. The wire rope  clamp  shall  provide  a  secure,  non-slip  connection  and  shall  be  free from cracks, burrs, casting defects or other manufacturing imperfections. All components shall be supplied complete and ready for installation. Including cost  of  materials,  labour,  usage  charges  of  machinery  complete  as  per specifications.
(Rate as per LQR) Rope Clamps

Providing and supplying 12 mm nominal size wire rope thimble, suitable for use  with  12  mm  (approximately  1/2  inch)  diameter  galvanized  steel  wire rope,  fabricated  from  high-quality  steel  and  designed  to  form  a  smooth, protected eye at the end of the wire rope. The thimble shall provide adequate support  to  the  wire  rope  around  the  eye,  prevent  excessive  bending  and abrasion,  and  maintain  the  shape  of  the  rope  termination  under  service conditions.  The  thimble  shall  be  of  heavy-duty  construction,  accurately formed  and  free  from  cracks,  sharp  edges,  burrs,  deformation  and  other manufacturing defects. It shall be suitable for outdoor exposure and shall be compatible  with  the  specified  wire  rope  and  associated  clamps/fittings. Including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions.(Rate as per LQR) Thimble 12mm

Providing   and   supplying   padded   seat   harness   for  guides,   suitable   for adventure    activities,    zip-line    operations,    rope    access    and    related applications, manufactured from high-strength webbing and durable padded materials. The harness shall provide comfortable and secure support during prolonged   use   and   shall   be   designed   for   easy  adjustment   and   quick donning/removal.  The  harness  shall  be  provided  with  three  quick-release buckles, comprising one buckle at the waist and adjustable ergonomic leg-loop  buckles,  allowing  secure  and  convenient  fitting  for  different  users.  It shall incorporate four gear/material loops, each rated for a maximum load of 5 kg, for carrying guide accessories and equipment. The harness shall have a  clearly  identifiable  12  mm  wide  contrasting-colour  belay  loop,  having  a minimum rated strength of 15 kN, securely integrated into the harness load-bearing    structure.    All    load-bearing    stitching,    webbing,    buckles    and attachment points shall be of high-quality construction and free from defects. Including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications.
(Rate as per LQR) Padded Seat Harness

Providing and supplying Quick Buckle (QB) seat harness for guests, suitable for use in adventure tourism activities, zip-line operations, climbing and other rope-based recreational applications. The harness shall be of universal, one-size-fits-all adjustable design, suitable for users ranging approximately from XXS to XXL, with secure and comfortable fitting through adjustable waist and leg  loops.  The  harness  shall  be  manufactured  from  high-strength  load-bearing webbing and durable components, incorporating quick-release, non-back-threading  buckles  for  rapid  and  safe  adjustment.  The  design  shall include  an  elevated  tie-in  point  positioned  above  the  waist  belt  to  facilitate proper attachment and improve user positioning during operation. Including cost  of  materials,  labour,  usage  charges  of  machinery  complete  as  per specifications and as per directions. 
(Rate as per LQR) Quick Buckle Seat Harness

Providing  and  supplying  Tandem  Track  Guide  Pulley  suitable  for  use  on steel  cables  and  ropes,  designed  for  adventure  tourism,  zip-line  and  rope-based recreational applications. The pulley shall be compact, lightweight and manufactured  from  high-quality,  corrosion-resistant  materials  for  reliable operation  under  outdoor  conditions.  The  pulley  shall  be  suitable  for  cable diameters  ranging  from  9  mm  to  13  mm,  and  may  also  be  used  with compatible ropes as recommended by the manufacturer. It shall incorporate an   aluminium   frame   and   carabiner,   stainless-steel   sheave   and   nylon components,  providing  a  durable  and  smooth-running  assembly.  Including cost  of  materials,  labour,  usage  charges  of  machinery  complete  as  per specifications and as per directions.
(Rate as per LQR) Tandem Track Guide Pulley

Providing  and  supplying  Vertigo  Wire-Lock  locking  carabiner,  suitable  for use  in  adventure  tourism,  zip-line,  climbing,  rope-access  and  other  safety-related   applications.   The   carabiner   shall   be   manufactured   from   high-strength,   lightweight   aluminium   alloy,   with   stainless-steel   spring/internal components  and  a  durable  nylon/polyamide  cover,  designed  to  provide secure  and  reliable  connection  between  harnesses,  lanyards,  pulleys  and approved anchorage/connection systems. The carabiner shall incorporate an automatic WIRE-LOCK locking system to prevent accidental opening of the gate  during  normal  use.  It  shall  have  a  wide  gate  opening  for  convenient clipping  and  shall  be  designed  for smooth  operation  and  repeated  outdoor use.   Including   cost   of   materials,   labour,   usage   charges   of   machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions.
(Rate as per LQR) Vertigo Wire Lock Carabineer

Providing and supplying Joko I 45 cm single-arm energy-absorbing lanyard, suitable for use in adventure tourism, climbing, via ferrata, zip-line and other safety-related  applications.  The  lanyard  shall  be  manufactured  from  high-quality polyester  and  thermoplastic  polyurethane  (TPU)  materials  and  shall provide  a  secure  connection  between  the  user's  harness  and  compatible anchorage  /  connection  equipment.  The  lanyard  shall  be  of  single-arm configuration,  compact  and  lightweight,  with  a  nominal  overall  length  of  45 cm  and  approximate  weight  of  65  g.  The  construction  shall  be  durable, flexible  and  suitable  for  repeated  outdoor  use.
